description: Token exchange: obtain a subject_token via JWT IdP login, then attempt RFC8693 token exchange requesting an audience that should not be allowed. If accepted, audience binding is violated.
invariant_hypothesis: I5: Token exchange must enforce audience narrowing; requested audience must be a subset of the subject token's allowed audiences. Exchanging to an unrelated audience should be rejected.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Token exchange accepted a requested audience outside the subject token's allowed audiences, violating audience binding.
Control JWT IdP login + intent retrieval should succeed; otherwise the audience-binding test is inconclusive.

description: SAML broker replay: reuse the same Assertion/@ID with OneTimeUse across two logins; broker must reject the second use to prevent permission re-grant beyond upstream intent.
invariant_hypothesis: I5: A SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse must not be accepted more than once; otherwise the broker can re-grant an authenticated session (and its effective permissions) beyond the upstream intent of a one-time credential.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login should succeed to establish baseline for OneTimeUse replay test
